column1: # env-contract.tsv — the ONE in-repo authority for Lupin's environment variables.
#   LUPIN_ROOT alone has 36 read sites and four writers (each machine's ~/.bashrc,
#   push-env, every compose `environment:` block, and a default inside
#   cu.get_project_root()) — and no list of which vars exist, who sets them, or what
#   shape they should have per machine. Every one of those is one fact asserted in
#   several places with nothing comparing them.
#   This is the CONTRACT, not the VALUES. Values are legitimately machine-specific
#   (/mnt/DATA01/... on dev vs /mnt/lupin-data/... on the VM) and must stay that way.
#   What is NOT machine-specific is WHICH vars must exist, WHO writes them, and WHAT
#   SHAPE they take — and that genuinely is one fact, so it lives here, once.
#   This is the same pattern as src/conf/claude-code-hooks.json: one in-repo authority,
#   machine-specific instantiation by a script. That is the pattern that has worked.
#   - src/scripts/preflight-vm.sh   check A1 — asserts each var per this contract.
#   - src/scripts/lupin-vm.sh       push-env — SHOULD generate from this file rather
#                                   than carrying its own hardcoded echo list
# FORMAT — tab-separated, 6 columns. '#' comments and blank lines ignored.
#   surface       HOST      — the VM/dev shell (~/.bashrc, push-env)
#                 BOTH      — must agree on both surfaces
#   writer        what is responsible for setting it.
#   shape         PATH_VM      — must live under the VM data root on a VM
#                 PATH_ANY     — a path, machine-specific, not otherwise constrained
#   requirement   REQUIRED — preflight BLOCKS when unset
#   note          why it exists / what breaks without it. Keep it factual.

column6: note

36 read sites. Container value is /var/lupin; host value is the checkout. cu.get_project_root() falls back to /var/lupin, which is CORRECT in a container and WRONG on a host — so an unset host value fails silently rather than loudly.
The alias library and the hook templates are relative to it. Aliases only REFERENCED it; nothing defined it until 5eb54324.
The alias library depends on it (878df337).

The interpreter for the MCP server AND the 8 hooks. Defaults to $LUPIN_ROOT/.venv, which on the VM is a SYMLINK to the arbiter's venv (uid 1001, py3.10) — missing deps and unwritable. The dev box masks this completely.
notify() target-user resolution. Without it: 401 "no target user". ~/.lupin/config global_notification_recipient is NOT read at runtime — this var is.

The X-API-Key (ck_live_ format), validated against a bcrypt hash in THAT SERVER'S api_keys table. PER-DATABASE — the dev key cannot validate on the VM. Never ship it from dev (reverted footgun 90b56fd4).
Required by lupin-vm.sh for every gcloud call. NB test_no_hardcoded_gcp_identifiers currently reports lupin-vm.sh hardcodes the sandbox value as well — an open pre-existing failure.
group_add for the app container so uid 1001 can read/write host-written CC session bridges. Absent => persona allocation 404s.
Bind source for the CC session bridges. A short ${HOME}-relative bind silently CREATES an empty dir when HOME is wrong — indistinguishable from "mounted but empty".
Chooses the DATABASE. Per cloud-test.yml's own comment it is "never inferred". Must AGREE with the INI block below — nothing compares them today (R4).
Chooses the INI BLOCK (e.g. Lupin:+Testing-GCS). A different knob from LUPIN_ENV with a similar name; they can disagree silently.
Only needed for direct Opus via Vertex on the VM.
Ranked BELOW GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT/GCLOUD_PROJECT — a literal elsewhere can silently bill another project.
Opus 4.8 on Vertex is GLOBAL-ONLY. A regional value yields model-not-found, which the CC wizard mis-reports as "permission denied".

column1: # Requirement below is COMPOSE'S OWN declaration, not a judgement call: `${VAR:?msg}`
# aborts `up` when unset (=> REQUIRED); `${VAR:-default}` cannot (=> OPTIONAL).

column6: project:region:instance for the cloud-sql-proxy sidecar AND the app. `${...:?}` in cloud-gpu.yml:61,181 and cloud-test.yml:60,107 — unset aborts `up` outright. Preflight C also probes the resulting socket at /cloudsql/<this>/.s.PGSQL.5432.
`${...:?}` (cloud-gpu.yml:184). Sourced from Secret Manager `lupin-db-password`. cloud-gpu.env is mode 600 / uid 1001 — a plain grep by the SSH user reads NOTHING, with no error.
Defaults to `lupin_app` in compose (cloud-gpu.yml:182). Absent is compliant; the default is the deployed value.
Defaults to `lupin_db_test` in compose (cloud-gpu.yml:183). NB the host dev engine is lupin_db_dev — code guarded by `if "lupin_db_test" not in db_url` never executes on the host.
The app image tag; defaults to `lupin:1.1.0` (cloud-gpu.yml:80). An unset value silently deploys the DEFAULT tag rather than failing, so a stale image looks like a successful deploy.
Model-server image tag, defaults to `0.1.0` (cloud-test.yml:151). Same silent-default hazard as LUPIN_IMAGE.

The Cloud Run service URL. REQUIRED is the VM's regime (`${...:?}` cloud-gpu.yml:193); the LOCAL docker-compose.yml gives it a `:-http://lupin-model-server:7998` default instead, so its requirement is venue-dependent and this contract states the VM's.

`${...:-}` (cloud-gpu.yml:199, cloud-test.yml:121) so unset resolves to EMPTY and never blocks `up`. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-07-26: the line is COMMENTED OUT at cloud-gpu.env:31, so it IS empty on the VM today. What that breaks is NOT established — read the consumer before asserting anything.
`${GH_TOKEN:-}` in the LOCAL docker-compose.yml only (:204, :348) — not interpolated by either cloud compose file. Unset resolves to empty; gh CLI calls inside the container then run unauthenticated.
Test/proxy auth as the SAME user, so both share a WebSocket channel. Absent => "Operation cancelled" failures.
